title: highlight studios
desc: Information and pricing for renting Penumbra's North light facing photographic studios, workshop spaces, and roof-top deck, for photo shoots, workspace, and events.

blocks.html:
highlight studios

New York City's only authentic North-light studio

Studio A is an authentic north-light studio built to optimal specifications established in the 1850s.
North-light photo studios were made famous in the 20th century by icons including Irving Penn and Richard Avedon.
The space has a sloped, north-facing wall of non-UV coated windows that allows for continuous soft light throughout the day.

1,200 sq ft
